# **Rethinking Reference-Based Pricing**


How flexible reimbursement strategies can help organizations navigate rising costs, changing markets and evolving business priorities.


Reference-based pricing is evolving. Explore how modern RBP approaches combine objective pricing, market intelligence, provider engagement and advanced analytics to support smarter reimbursement strategies.


## **Make More Informed Reimbursement Decisions By:**


- Understanding what’s driving renewed interest in RBP
- Exploring how modern RBP has evolved
- Matching reimbursement approaches to business needs
- Balancing cost, provider and member priorities
- Using data, AI and market insight to inform strategy
